published.source: Report re-sim on master abd7cd3, 2026-10-16: no level-based partial resist (#102) and the pass 23 rotations (#98 to #105) (was 966.3)

summary: Keeps Battle Shout up for its party, with the raid's Battle Shout off.
rotation: Start with no Rage; Bloodrage and Battle Shout 3s before the pull, then Battle Stance, Charge for 15 Rage and back to Berserker Stance
Sunder Armor as the first GCD after the pull (every warrior; the tanks keep it up after)
Battle Shout again with 35s of it left (about 142s in, before the execute phase), unless it lasts the fight (Forever's lasts 3 min)
Death Wish held for the last 36s, Recklessness for the last 30s
Blood Fury and Berserking held for the last 30s, Elune's Light with Death Wish; Mighty Rage Potion at the pull, second held for the last 20s
Bloodthirst, then Slam from 30 Rage right after a main hand swing, then Whirlwind at 25+ Rage
Execute in the execute phase, after Bloodthirst and Whirlwind (Execute first loses 4.7 on Fury and 22.7 on two-hand Fury)
Heroic Strike queued from 90 Rage (outside execute)
caveats: The on-use trinket's last use is held for the final 34s.
White hit Rage scales with weapon speed (measured at level 30, assumed ×1.5 at 60).
No Ahn'Qiraj book ranks (Heroic Strike VIII, raid Battle Shout VI, Strength of Earth, Grace of Air)
Assumed: the crit Rage bonus is white hits only, and Heroic Strike counts for Unbridled Wrath.
One +2% crit elixir. A second (Grizzly) would add 12.0.
Battlegear of Glory 4-piece not counted. It would add 8.8 vs Humanoids.
Holding Death Wish for 36s: +3.5 at 180s, -4 at 120s.
Raid damage hits (2 a minute, about 15 Rage each) are an estimate.
notes: Request from mksettings -spec fury -gear level60_phase1_synthetic_arms -apl level60_fury_2h_battle_shout -talents 30305013032-25053000152110501 -race Orc -duration 180, then the raid's battleShout removed (standards 23: the duty preset's own shout is the only one). Raid buffs, Kings and Might, debuffs, consumes, professions (Engineering, Alchemy) and the Level 60 encounter match ui/warrior/presets.ts. Uses the Fury class options (Berserker Stance) as the preset build does; the preset's DefaultConsumes keep an off-hand stone, which has no effect without an off hand.
